episodeTitle.en: An inside look at how Miro builds product | Varun Parmar (CPO of Miro)

guestBioOfficial.en: Varun Parmar is the Chief Product Officer of Miro and has over two decades of experience in the tech industry. Prior to joining Miro, Varun held executive positions as Chief Product Officer at Box and Syncplicity (acquired by Dell EMC) and spent six years in product management at Adobe. He also co-founded Doculus, which was later acquired by Box. In today’s episode, we discuss: • The importance of empathy and how to foster it

title.en: An inside look at how Miro builds product | Varun Parmar (CPO of Miro)

summary.en: Varun discusses what makes Miro's product culture distinctive, how a visual-collaboration company scales while staying close to users, and lessons from leading product at both Box and Miro. He covers product-led growth, the role of craft and design, and how to keep quality high as a collaboration tool expands across enterprises. The episode is a practitioner's view of building beloved B2B products.
summary.zh: Varun 讨论了是什么让 Miro 的产品文化独具特色、一家视觉协作公司如何在贴近用户的同时规模化，以及从在 Box 与 Miro 领导产品中学到的经验。他涵盖了产品驱动增长、工艺与设计的作用，以及当协作工具向企业扩张时如何保持高品质。本期是关于打造受人喜爱的 B2B 产品的实践者视角。
